'''Aleksandr Viktorovich Gurevich''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Викторович Гуревич}}; 19 September 1930 – 21 July 2023) was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and Russian physicist. In 1992 he proposed the theory of [[lightning]] initiation known as the "[[runaway breakdown]]".

Gurevich was born on 19 September 1930.<ref>{{in lang|ru}}[http://ufn.ru/ufn2000/ufn00_11/Russian/rper0011a.pdf Aleksandr Viktorovich Gurevich] - article in [[Uspekhi Fizicheskikh Nauk]] on his 70th anniversary</ref> He graduated from [[Moscow State University]] in 1952. In 1984 he became a Corresponding Member of the [[USSR Academy of Sciences]] ([[Russian Academy of Sciences]] since 1991).<ref>[http://www.biografija.ru/show_bio.aspx?id=31459 Биография.ру | Biografija.ru | Г | Гуревич Александр Викторович<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> He was the head of the [[Igor Tamm|I. E. Tamm]] Theoretical Department at the [[Lebedev Physical Institute]]. From 2010 he was the head of Academic Department of Physics and Astrophysics Problems in Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.dgap.mipt.ru/department/chairs/physics/ |title=Факультет общей и прикладной физики: Проблемы физики и астрофизики |accessdate=15 August 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100831050226/http://www.dgap.mipt.ru/department/chairs/physics/ |archivedate=31 August 2010 }}</ref>

Aleksandr Gurevich died on 21 July 2023, at the age of 92.<ref>[https://lebedev.ru/ru/main-news/news/3779-ushjol-iz-zhizni-aleksandr-viktorovich-gurevich-19-sentyabrya-1930-g-21-iyulya-2023-g.html Ушёл из жизни Александр Викторович Гуревич 19 сентября 1930 г. - 21 июля 2023 г.] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>

==Fields of Research==
His work has focused on:

* [[Plasma kinetics]] (1955-)
* [[Ionospheric physics]] (1955-)
* [[Nonlinear dynamics]] of non-collisional [[Plasma (physics)|plasmas]] (1963-)
* Nonlinear waves in [[dispersive hydrodynamics]] (1973-)
* Artificial [[ionized layers]] in the atmosphere (1977-) 
* The [[electrodynamics]] of [[neutron star]] [[magnetosphere]]s (1983–1993)
* Nonlinear dynamics of [[dark matter]] (1988-)
